CVE-2024-30161.description: In Qt 6.5.4, 6.5.5, and 6.6.2, QNetworkReply header data might be accessed via a dangling pointer in Qt for WebAssembly (wasm). (Earlier and later versions are unaffected.)

CVE-2025-23050.title: QLowEnergyController in Qt before 6.8.2 mishandles malformed Blue ...
CVE-2025-23050.description: QLowEnergyController in Qt before 6.8.2 mishandles malformed Bluetooth ATT commands, leading to an out-of-bounds read (or division by zero). This is fixed in 5.15.19, 6.5.9, and 6.8.2.

CVE-2025-3512.title: There is a Heap-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in QTextMarkd ...
CVE-2025-3512.description:
There is a Heap-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in QTextMarkdownImporter. This requires an incorrectly formatted markdown file to be passed to QTextMarkdownImporter to trigger the overflow.

This issue affects Qt from 6.8.0 to 6.8.4. Versions up to 6.6.0 are known to be unaffected, and the fix is in 6.8.4 and later.

CVE-2025-5683.title: When loading a specifically crafted ICNS format image file in QIm ...
CVE-2025-5683.description:
When loading a specifically crafted ICNS format image file in QImage then it will trigger a crash. 

This issue affects Qt from versions 6.3.0 through 6.5.9, from 6.6.0 through 6.8.4, 6.9.0. This is fixed in 6.5.10, 6.8.5 and 6.9.1.

CVE-2025-5992.title: When passing values outside of the expected range to QColorTransf ...
CVE-2025-5992.description:
When passing values outside of the expected range to QColorTransferGenericFunction it can cause a denial of service, for example, this can happen when passing a specifically crafted ICC profile to QColorSpace::fromICCProfile.

This issue affects Qt from 6.6.0 through 6.8.3, from 6.9.0 through 6.9.1. This is fixed in 6.8.4 and 6.9.2.

CVE-2026-19395.title: In Qt for MCUs, a Text element that displays styled text halts th ...
CVE-2026-19395.description: In Qt for MCUs, a Text element that displays styled text halts the device if an tag in the text contains an attribute with an empty value. The text parser passes the empty value to an internal check that only accepts non-empty values. The check fails and reports an error, and the default error handler halts the device.

CVE-2026-78253.description: Uncontrolled recursion in QXmlStreamReader::readElementText() in Qt Group Qt allows attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash via stack exhaustion) via a crafted XML document.

CVE-2026-94370.title: A defect in the Qt for MCUs core string handling causes heap memo ...
CVE-2026-94370.description: A defect in the Qt for MCUs core string handling causes heap memory corruption. When an application passes text into Qt Quick Ultralite using the public Qul::String interface type, and that text is held in a std::string, the conversion to the internal string type copies the pointer without taking ownership of it. Two objects then release the same memory, producing a double free, an invalid free, or a use-after-free.
